id: title:Gilbert09:add error monitors as self driving inbox sources

review.posthog_relevance: Adds support for three new external signal sources (Checkly, Roark, Trigger.dev) to the PostHog Signals inbox, expanding the range of monitored DevOps and workflow events.
review.reason: Adds three new signal sources (Checkly, Roark, Trigger.dev) to the frontend inbox and backend type definitions. P1.F9.H1, P1.F9.H2, P1.F9.H3 add the source identifiers to the frontend configuration. P1.F10.H8, P1.F10.H9 update the backend union type. P1.F11.H1 defines the backend response schema for Checkly. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks backend implementation, migration scripts, and complete frontend implementation, preventing a Tier 3 assessment. No tests or migration evidence is present. No tier assignment is made here; scoring requires the complete group review.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation, tests, or migration scripts for the three new signal sources. It also does not include the complete backend configuration or the complete frontend implementation. Therefore, while the frontend and backend configuration are present, the complete implementation and tests are not. This chunk is not sufficient to establish tier 2.
